server.host_name.description: Custom mDNS host name to publish (leave empty to use system hostname)

server.domain_name.description: Domain suffix to use for mDNS names (typically 'local')

reflector.enabled.description: Enable DNS-SD service reflection across subnets (required only for multi-subnet discovery)

discovery.allow_interfaces.description: List of interfaces Avahi will use for mDNS/DNS-SD discovery (use empty list to allow all)
